newsitem.title: NORWAY: Norwegian avalanche kills two, others evacuated.
newsitem.headline: Norwegian avalanche kills two, others evacuated.

text.p: An avalanche in Arctic Norway killed an elderly couple and forced the evacuation of about 60 people from villages near Tromsoe city, the national news agency NTB said on Saturday.
The man and the women, aged 70 and 71, were found dead on Friday night in a house hit by the avalanche in Breivikeidet on a fjord outside Tromsoe, the report said.
They were the first victims of the bad weather in the area. Roads have been closed for days because of snow storms.
Two coastguard vessels brought the evacuees from Breivikeidet and other villages threatened by the snow. They were billeted in a hotel in Tromsoe, NTB said.
It said about 20 people were still in Breivikeidet and refused to be evacuated, saying they felt safe at home. Police were trying to persuade them to move to Tromsoe, the report said.
